name: Inshoku no Jokumu
source:
Nobuo is a high school student. He is quiet and teased by other students - mainly girls - at school.
One day, he decides to order a pillow. It seems people can have a good dream using it. A several days later, it arrives and he immediately uses it. He dreams of the girls who always tease him.
It goes like this: Some tentacles suddenly appear from his body and start raping them.... On the next day, the girls he raped in his dream are absent. He doesn't know why...

[Edited from Erogeshop]
translation:
伸夫是一名高中生。他很安静，在学校经常被其他学生（主要是女孩）取笑。
有一天，他决定订购一个枕头。看来人们用它可以做个好梦。几天后，它到达了，他立即使用了它。他梦见那些总是取笑他的女孩。
事情是这样的：一些触手突然从他的身体里出现，开始强奸……第二天，他在梦中强奸的女孩却不见了。他不知道为什么…
